params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Rengar}} generates {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} when he casts a basic ability or uses ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' empowered attack, which expires after a period [[out of combat]]. At max {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}}, his next basic ability consumes them to become empowered with an additional effect, gain an extra cast, and briefly grant him {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} '''Rengar''' generates a permanent [[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|link=]] ''Trophy'' stack for each unique {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' basic {{sti|attack range}} is increased and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target. This generates {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-hit}} if he had none at one point.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon casting a {{tip|Champion ability|basic ability}} or using ''{{ais|Savagery|Rengar}}'' first attack, '''Rengar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} for {{tt|1 second|counting from the end of attack windup or cast time}}, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers {{bug|2}}. At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|30 to 50 for 3|1 to 13|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds. Generated {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by [[damage over time]] or [[Damage#Engine_level|proc]] effects.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Rengar''' gains ''Unseen Predator'', which lingers for {{fd|0.35}} seconds upon exiting brush. ''Unseen Predator'' is lost immediately if '''Rengar''' exits the brush using {{si|Flash}} or {{si|Hexflash}}.
params.description3:
{{sbc|Unseen Predator:}} '''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-attack}} generates {{as|1 Ferocity|buzzword3}} if none of his {{tt|{{as|current Ferocity|buzzword3}} was generated this way|The next use of Unseen Predator after consuming all Ferocity from an empowered ability will count for this effect}}. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them.

'''''Rengar''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of '''Rengar's''' {{tip|attack windup}}, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects and additionally refreshing the {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} duration.''
params.description4: {{Anchor|Bonetooth Necklace}}{{sbc|Innate - Bonetooth Necklace:}} Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them grants '''Rengar''' a ''Trophy'', once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional ''Trophy'' is made available through the event ''[[The Hunt is On!]]'' with the [[File:Head of Kha'Zix.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Head of Kha'Zix''. ''Trophies'' grant {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|adjustsize|link=]] Trophies|key=%|x^2 for 6|x;Head of Kha'Zix|formula=(Number of Trophies) * (Number of Trophies)}} '''bonus''' AD}}.
params.target range: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|50|Landing distance from target's location at dash start, determines dash length}}
params.notes: * '''Rengar''' has a secondary resource bar that indicates how much {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} he currently has as pips. ** {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} generated by ''Unseen Predator'' has a purple color. ** Ferocity generated by his other abilities has a white color. {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * While out of combat, if abilities are used one after the other, only the first will count towards the 1 second {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} timer, without refreshing from the second cast. [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/104] {{bug|2|Appeared undocumented on V26.01}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I|estimatedPatchOrigin=V26.01|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776018778|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * Reaching 4 {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}} with an ability immediatelly grants access to empowered abilities, however reaching it with a brush attack will grant the access after a short delay - causing '''Rengar''' to still be able to cast normal abilities while at 4 {{as|Ferocity|buzzword3}}. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r_mNm0YNmno] [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/90] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I|estimatedPatchOrigin=V12.6|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776216303|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} * Only {{si|Flash}} and {{si|Hexflash}} instantly end ''Unseen Predator''. Other {{tip|blink}} effects will still cause the buff to linger upon exiting the {{tip|brush}} area. * The attack deals {{tip|basic damage}} but is considered {{tip|ability damage}} for {{ii|Spear of Shojin}}. * While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Rengar''' loses the enhanced {{sti|attack range}} from ''Unseen Predator''. * {{iis|Rapid Firecannon}} and {{ais|Savagery|Rengar}} '''bonus''' ranges are lost after {{fd|0.25}} seconds upon gaining ''Unseen Predator'', and are re-gained after {{fd|0.25}} seconds upon losing ''Unseen Predator''. ** The same does not apply for other '''bonus''' ranges such as {{iis|Hexoptics C44}}. * '''Rengar''' will only leap to a target if his basic attack timer has been refreshed (if not so he will not automatically attempt to path towards his target, despite them being within leap range). {{safesubst:unexpected|desc= * The leap will consume {{tip|energized}} {{tip|on-attack}} but only expend it once the leap hits. ** If the leap is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, the ''energized'' will be indefinitely stored in the background until expended by a successive leap. Only 1 ''energized'' may be stored, but another can continue to recharge on the buffbar. *** While the ''energized'' is stored, normal basic attacks are prevented from expending any energized, however abilities may still expend the one from the buffbar. [https://github.com/ArdaSenyurek/Rengar-Bugs/issues/120] {{bug|2|Started on V26.02}}|affectedEffects=Rengar I; Energized|estimatedPatchOrigin=V26.02|wikiUploadTimestamp=1776293554|pagename=Template:Data Rengar/Unseen Predator }} * '''Rengar''' can freely use any {{tip|abilities}}, [[summoner spell]]s, or [[active ability items|item actives]] while leaping. ** Using a {{tip|dash}} or {{tip|blink}} ability will interrupt the leap. * The attack from the leap will: ** ''Not'' go off if the dash was interrupted. ** ''Not'' go off if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}. ** Go off at the end of the dash even if its normal destination is obstructed by boundaries he cannot cross (e.g. terrain, {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}}). ** Go off regardless of distance the enemy travels away from '''Rengar's''' original location. ** Go off even if '''Rengar''' loses {{tip|sight}} of the target. * {{as|{{sti|ad|Bonus AD}}|ad}} percent from ''Bonetooth Necklace'' [[recursion|stacks recursively]] with {{bi|Infernal Might}}, {{iis|Overlord's Bloodmail}} {{nie|Tyranny}} and [[Role Quests#Quests|mid lane quest's]] {{as|bonus AD}} multiplier. * ''Bonetooth Necklace'' uses different icons corresponding to the number of stacks acquired: ** {{sbc|1 Stack:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|2 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 2.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|3 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 3.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|4 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 4.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|5 Stacks:}} [[File:Bonetooth Necklace 5.png|20px|border|link=]] ** {{sbc|6th Stack:}} [[File:Head of Kha'Zix item.png|20px|border|link=]] '''Head of Kha'Zix'''
params.tips: * Since the attack timer is only put on cooldown at the start of the leap, '''Rengar''' can {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} it mid leap (i.e via {{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}) to immediatelly perform a successive attack after leap end has hit.

blurb.plain: Innate: Rengar generates Ferocity when he casts a basic ability or uses Savagery empowered attack, which expires after a period out of combat. At max Ferocity, his next basic ability consumes them to become empowered with an additional effect, gain an extra cast, and briefly grant him bonus movement speed.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Bonetooth Necklace: Rengar generates a permanent Trophy stack for each unique takedown against an enemy champion, gaining bonus attack damage.

blurb3.plain: Innate: While in brush, Rengar gains Unseen Predator.

blurb4.plain: Unseen Predator: Rengar's basic attack range is increased and causes him to leap to the target. This generates Ferocity on-hit if he had none at one point.

description.plain: Innate: Upon casting a basic ability or using Savagery first attack, Rengar generates a stack of Ferocity for 1 second, stacking up 4 times but not refreshing on subsequent triggers ⟦bug⟧. At maximum stacks, his next basic ability consumes them all to become empowered with an additional effect and grant him an additional cast along with 30% – 50% (based on level) bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Generated Ferocity is prevented from expiring for 10 seconds after dealing or taking damage, excluding damage dealt by damage over time or proc effects.

description2.plain: Innate: While in brush, Rengar gains Unseen Predator, which lingers for 0.35 seconds upon exiting brush. Unseen Predator is lost immediately if Rengar exits the brush using Flash or Hexflash.

description3.plain: Unseen Predator: Rengar's next basic attack on-attack generates 1 Ferocity if none of his current Ferocity was generated this way. The attack also has massively increased range and causes him to leap to the target's location if they are beyond his normal basic attack range, attacking the target upon arrival and landing 50 units in front of them. Rengar can cast any of his abilities during the dash. The start of the leap is the end of Rengar's attack windup, putting the attack timer on cooldown, triggering on-attack effects and additionally refreshing the Ferocity duration.

description4.plain: Innate - Bonetooth Necklace: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them grants Rengar a Trophy, once per unique champion and up to 5. An additional Trophy is made available through the event The Hunt is On! with the Head of Kha'Zix. Trophies grant bonus attack damage equal to ⟦pp⟧ bonus AD.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rengar}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for his next two {{tip|basic attacks}}. His next basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and will {{tip|critically strike}}, dealing increased damage based on his {{sti|{{as|critical strike chance}}}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Savagery 2|Rengar|Ferocity}} Bonus:}} ''Savagery's'' damage is modified and '''Rengar''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' gains {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} within 3 seconds.
params.description2: His first attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to stab the target, having an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gaining {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}}, and dealing {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Savagery's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|35 to 140 for 8; 150 + (240-150)/9*(x-1) for 12|formula = 20 + 15 per level until level 8, then + 10 per level|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. In addition to gaining another instance of the base attack speed on-cast, consuming the attack also grants {{as|{{pp|key=%|50 + (101-50)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' attack speed}} for 5 seconds.

blurb.plain: Active: Rengar gains bonus attack speed for his next two basic attacks. His next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and will critically strike, dealing increased damage based on his critical strike chance.

blurb4.plain: Ferocity Bonus: Savagery's damage is modified and Rengar gains bonus attack speed for a few seconds.

description.plain: Active: Rengar gains 40% bonus attack speed on his next two basic attacks on-attack within 3 seconds.

description2.plain: His first attack on-hit is empowered to stab the target, having an uncancellable windup, gaining 25 bonus range, and dealing additional physical damage.

description3.plain: Ferocity Bonus: Savagery's damage is modified to deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 20% AD) bonus physical damage. In addition to gaining another instance of the base attack speed on-cast, consuming the attack also grants ⟦pp⟧ bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

description4.plain: Savagery resets Rengar's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Rengar}} stores [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] equal to a portion of damage taken within a brief moment.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' roars, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and consuming his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} himself.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Battle Roar 2|Rengar|Ferocity}} Bonus:}} ''Battle Roar's'' damage is modified. '''Rengar''' also {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} from {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' stores 50% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he has taken in the last {{fd|1.5}} seconds as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased to 100% of damage taken from {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' roars, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{as|{{pp|65 + (130-65)/17*(x-1) for 20}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}, and consuming his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.
params.description3: {{sbc|Ferocity Bonus:}} ''Battle Roar's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (220-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. '''Rengar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}}.
params.tips: * If '''Rengar''' uses both ''Battle Roar'' and its empowered version in quick succession he will heal for 100% of the damage he received in the last few seconds.

blurb.plain: Passive: Rengar stores grey health equal to a portion of damage taken within a brief moment.

blurb2.plain: Active: Rengar roars, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and consuming his grey health to heal himself.

description.plain: Passive: Rengar stores 50% of the post-mitigation damage he has taken in the last 1.5 seconds as grey health on his health bar, increased to 100% of damage taken from monsters.

description2.plain: Active: Rengar roars, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and ⟦pp⟧ bonus magic damage to monsters, and consuming his grey health to heal for the same amount.

description3.plain: Ferocity Bonus: Battle Roar's damage is modified to deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 80% AP) magic damage. Rengar cleanses himself from all crowd control.

description2.plain: Ferocity Bonus: Bola Strike's damage is modified to deal ⟦pp⟧ (+ 80% bonus AD) physical damage. The target is rooted instead of slowed.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' prowls for some time, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After a short delay, he also becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} and gains {{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}.
params.blurb3:
During this time, '''Rengar''' will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the remaining full duration. As he approaches, he will [[File:Thrill of the Hunt 2.png|24px]] mark the nearest detected enemy.

'''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, then {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|reduce the target's armor}}}} for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rengar''' also gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}'' while {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} from any source.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rengar''' prowls for a duration, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After a 2-second delay, he also becomes {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} and gains ''{{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}''.
The camouflage can only last up to 14 seconds. {{bug|2}}
params.leveling2: {{st|Effect Duration|{{ap|12 to 20}} seconds}}{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
params.description3: During this time, '''Rengar''' will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} and gaining {{tip|sight}} of a 100-unit radius around them. Enemies detected are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for the remaining full duration.

params.description5:
'''Rengar's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{sti|range|icononly=true}} {{ccd|Rengar|range}} range against any enemy or with ''Unseen Predator'' to the marked enemy deals {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}} and then inflicts {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
The target is {{tip|true sight|revealed}} until the leap has finished.
params.description6: [[Basic attack|Attacking]] or casting [[champion ability|abilities]] other than ''{{ai|Savagery|Rengar}}'' ends ''Thrill of the Hunt'' immediately.

blurb3.plain:
During this time, Rengar will detect the nearest enemy champion in range, revealing them for the remaining full duration. As he approaches, he will mark the nearest detected enemy.
 Rengar's next basic attack will deal bonus physical damage, then reduce the target's armor for a few seconds.

description.plain: Passive: Rengar also gains Unseen Predator while camouflaged from any source.

description2.plain:
Active: Rengar prowls for a duration, gaining bonus movement speed. After a 2-second delay, he also becomes camouflaged and gains Unseen Predator.
